question: Who among the following was a World War II veteran, also associated with cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Alan Burgess.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Alan Burgess was a former New Zealand cricketer and as well as was a World War II veteran.**
 
• He played first-class cricket for Canterbury from 1940 to 1952.
 
• During World War II, he served as a tank driver.
 
• He joined the New Zealand Army in 1941.
